title.narrative: Integrated, multi-stakeholder approach for high-impact pipeline development (GCF Readiness)

description.narrative: As the Delivery Partner, GGGI will support Kiribati's Ministry of Finance and Economic Development (i.e. the NDA) to catalyze collaboration and capacities at the national, sub-national and sectoral level so that the country as a whole can effectively engage with the GCF and other international partners to mobilize climate finance for the implementation of resilient development.The project seeks to enhance the capability of the NDA and the Climate Finance Division to perform adequately in its role. The project also seeks to provide other key government and non-government entities with adequate capacity, systems and networks to support the planning, programming and implementation of GCF-funded activities.
